operators.name: custom_tril
semantics: Implements torch.tril(x) for a 4D tensor, zeroing elements above the diagonal in the last two dimensions.
For each batch b and channel c, output[b, c, i, j] = 0 if j > i, else x[b, c, i, j].
Preserves input shape, stride (assuming contiguous input), and dtype.

operators.name: custom_elu
semantics: Implements F.elu(x) with alpha=1.0.
For each element x, output = x if x > 0, else exp(x) - 1.
Preserves shape, dtype, and device.

operators.name: custom_add_bias
semantics: Implements x + bias with PyTorch broadcasting.
bias shape (64, 1, 1) broadcasts to (1024, 64, 32, 32) by adding bias[c] to every spatial element in channel c for each batch.
For each element, output[b, c, i, j] = x[b, c, i, j] + bias[c, 0, 0].
Preserves shape, dtype, and device.
Applies torch.tril to the 4D input tensor x, zeroing entries above the diagonal in the last two dimensions.
Output shape remains [1024, 64, 32, 32], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Implemented as custom_tril.
Applies ELU activation with default alpha=1.0 elementwise.
Output shape remains [1024, 64, 32, 32], dtype float32, device cuda:0.

Adds bias tensor of shape (64,1,1) to x via broadcasting.
Output shape remains [1024, 64, 32, 32], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
